cases.name: Ashley M. Henning
cases.about: She was in the U.S. Army. MSG Henning was assigned to Ft. Knox, Kentucky when she tragically was killed.Since joining the Army in 2005, MSG Henning has served in a number of locations including several overseas assignment Iraq, Afghanistan, and Kuwait. Her awards and decorations include; Army Commendation Medal (6th Award), Army Achievement Award (4th Award), Army Good Conduct Medal (5th Award), National Defense Service Medal, Afghanistan Campaign Medal with campaign star, Iraq Campaign Medal with campaign star, Global War on Terrorism Expeditionary Medal, Global War on Terrorism Service Medal, Armed Forces Service Medal, Noncommissioned Officer Professional Development Ribbon (3rd Award), Army Service Ribbon, Overseas Service Ribbon (3rd Ribbon), NATO Medal, Meritorious Unit Commendation (2nd Award), and Driver and Mechanic Badge.
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her multiple times and killed her at her birthday party celebration.
